notes: ROBOTS: https://www.fenwick.co.uk/robots.txt fetched FIRST, before any other request on the host - HTTP 200, 3,618 bytes, profile chrome131. It is a Shopify storefront file ('# Shopify storefront. Public product, collection, page, blog, policy, cart, and localized HTML is crawlable.'). It names NO Claude agent anywhere - a regex sweep for claude / claudebot / claude-web / claude-user / anthropic returned ZERO matches - so there is no named-agent group and no hard stop. Only two groups exist: 'User-agent: *' which opens with 'Allow: /', and 'User-agent: adsbot-google'. We fall under '*'. Its Disallow list is private/transactional and crawl-trap paths: /admin, /cart/, /checkout, /checkouts/, /orders, /account, /85707063630, /cdn/wpm/*.js, /services, /sf_*, /cart.js, /recommendations/products, plus the filter/sort traps 'Disallow: /collections/*sort_by*', 'Disallow: /collections/*+*' (and %2B/%2b forms), 'Disallow: /collections/*filter*&*filter*', 'Disallow: /*?*ls=*&ls=*', '/*?*oseid=*', '/*?*preview_theme_id=*', '/*?*preview_script_id=*'. COMPLIANCE: every URL touched this session is a bare /collections/<handle> path or that same path with '?view=fallback' and/or '&page=N' - no sort_by, no '+', no filter parameter at all (never mind two), no oseid/preview/ls param, and the site's internal /search was never used. No Crawl-delay is declared for any user-agent; probe.py's 2 s per-host gap was honoured throughout. ACCESS: plain direct probe.py curl_cffi fetches (chrome131, edge101, safari17_0, safari17_2_ios, safari18_0, safari18_0_ios) - no proxy, no r.jina.ai, no campaign parameter, no browser automation, zero 403s and no WAF challenge at any point. TREE SOURCE - the site's OWN navigation, not guessed patterns, corroborated three ways: (a) the homepage/PLP mega-menu, whose Home & Tech column ends 'Bathroom | Towels | Bathroom Accessories | Bathmats'; (b) each PLP's own child carousel, div.collection-sub-navigation, which is what recovered the THIRD level the mega-menu truncates - Bathroom Accessories' carousel yields Laundry Baskets, Bathroom Bins, Soap Dispensers and Towels' yields Bath Towels, Hand Towels, Face Towels; (c) https://fenwick.co.uk/sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml + sitemap_collections_2.xml, 3,181 collection URLs, swept with the regex bath|shower|toilet|soap|basin|sink|tap|faucet|vanity|mirror|towel|wash|dispenser|toothbrush|sanitar|bidet|robe|wc|tumbler|caddy|hamper -> 85 hits, every one of which was triaged. The sitemap sweep is what surfaced the two unlinked collections reported in review (bath-robes, kids-nursery bathroom-accessories) and confirmed there is no hidden sanitaryware, tap, shower or bathroom-furniture branch: Fenwick is a department store whose bathroom offer is towels, bathmats and small accessories only. The 85 hits break down as ~40 Beauty 'Bath & Body' brand/skincare collections (bath soaks, shower gels, hand washes - toiletries, not bathroom fittings), plus womenswear robes/nightwear, wardrobes, hampers, washbags, eau de toilette, 'Robert' brand names and 'tapered' jeans - all keyword false positives, none opened as bathroom nodes. The site itself exposes a server-rendered fallback listing view, discovered from Fenwick's own markup (a pagination anchor in the shipped HTML reads '/collections/sale-kids?view=fallback&...&page=1'), and every count here is the exact total printed on that page by the site, verbatim '342 products', '256 products', '41 products', etc. The '?view=fallback&page=N' parameters are a FETCH DETAIL ONLY: they are not robots-disallowed, and every URL written into rows[] and review[] is the clean canonical /collections/<handle> form. The exclusion index holds 25 fenwick.co.uk URLs, all from Furniture.xlsx and all in the separate 'Furniture & Outdoor' / 'Luxury and Designer' tree (sofas, armchairs, coffee/console/side tables, sideboards, display cabinets, dining tables and chairs, desks, bookcases, bed frames, bedside tables, wardrobes, chest of drawers, dressing tables, garden furniture, nursery furniture) - not one is under /collections/home-and-tech-bathroom*, so no Option-1 vanity/cabinet suppression applies here and nothing recorded overlaps the Furniture pass.
